title: New Baths: Curating Bathroom Style, Starting With The Bath
bodyHtml:
Weaving Cohesive Design in the Bathroom, Starting with the Bath

This week, we're diving deep into the art of seamless design, using a statement bath as the centerpiece to set the style and effortlessly harmonize your bathroom.

Discover how our carefully curated range of toilets and basins blend with an array of Bath styles, so you can easily create a cohesive and consistent design aesthetic throughout your space.

The Nur Bath
Soft Curves and our Signature Floating Aesthetic

The brand new Nur Freestanding Bath is the latest addition to our signature Collection Organic.

Perfect for contemporary bathrooms where soft curves dominate, Nur mirrors the trademark curve of the Organic Collection. The aesthetic continuity extends seamlessly, creating a captivating 'floating' appearance with its subtle underskirt, working perfectly with our Milady Toilet range, and Nur Basins.

Discover Collection Organic

The Impero Bath
A Classic Era, Redefined for the Present

The Impero bath serves as the perfect centrepiece for any Federation bathroom, where traditional styling seamlessly merges with modern comfort and technology.

Complete the Federation style experience with the Impero Collection, a complete range of bathroom furnishings, where the grace of tradition meets the convenience of now.

Discover Collection Federation

The Decus Bath
Refined Angles over a Soft Chamfer Base

Defined by its soft chamfer base that gracefully meets the floor, the Decus Bath is a culmination of refined architectural edges and inspired simplicity.

Drawing from simple geometric shapes, our Decus Collection carries an air of softness in its overall aesthetic that works effortlessly throughout the entire range of Basins and Rimless Toilets.

Discover Collection Decus

Made with MarmoTech
Premium Stone Composite Suspended in Resin. 100% Silica Free.

Constructed from a formulation of premium stone composite materials, each bath undergoes a meticulous process, ensuring the highest standards of quality and durability.

The result is a freestanding bath with a luxurious tactile finish, that not only feels exquisite but also warms quickly and helps maintains water temperature ensuring longer moments of relaxation and tranquility.

MarmoTech is a non-porous and easy to clean surface, preventing dirt and grime build up making it a hygienic choice for your bathroom.
